notes: Vacancies view of the DFS site (server-rendered Drupal, 30 entries per page, newest first) and its second pager page (?page=1, the last page on the capture date: 4 entries, one of them repeated). HTML stored exactly as returned by FetchResult.html (UTF-8); no browser was needed. The registry's recruitment URL https://financialservices.gov.in/beta/en/vacancies answered HTTP 404 through the same fetcher on the capture date. The page shows PUBLISHED DATE / START DATE / DUE DATE fields (yyyy-mm-dd, often empty) and no advertisement numbers.
